name: 3D Tibi numeric QA (scripts/rig3d-check.js)
purpose: Checks the 3D Tibi without rendering: per-frame continuity (teleporting joints), activation colour steps, muscle presence and size, planted soles, IK reach, joint limits and per-exercise assertions.
capabilities: fitness.py rig3d check [exercise ...] (node, exit 1 on failure)
IK-to-FK seek recovery: direct leg poses cannot retain a previous heel lift
--profile legacy|distance (distance default) selects the same body variant as the bench and films
Actual composited skin and cloth colour changes are measured per frame, in addition to muscle ramp records
Framing (distance profile): every declared shot fitted on a 720x1280 stage must keep body and equipment in frame at every sampled frame; the fixed def.camera overflow is reported

installation.instructions: Workspace file; python3.12 (jsonschema) for schema checks.

compatibility.runtime: node for the check; headless Chrome from the HyperFrames install and Pillow for the stills
compatibility.notes: Node-only numeric checks with current/legacy profile selection and actual surface-colour steps. Historical Mac results do not cover the current 1.10.0 body; Mac rerun pending.

licensing.notes: Internal workspace component; no third-party code copied.

approval_evidence: 2026-11-20, Windows: nine rig tests pass across all eight exercises, both bodies and both profiles. The actual-colour gate caught an early compositor regression, then passed after the source correction; the 0.12 channel-step limit and exercise timing were not relaxed. Mac rerun pending.
